<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400">
  <title>Stella octangula — 276 pixels, two interpenetrating tetrahedra</title>
  <!-- Native CAD elevation: path endpoints are first/last of 23 equal diffuser-bin centres. Horizontal X is illustrative; electrical directions and corner pairings are measured. -->
  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="#101321"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="5">
    <!-- T1: upward tetrahedron; actual profile offsets and inset pixel centres need not meet at connector vertices. -->
    <g stroke="#54c8df">
      <path id="T1-E1" d="M 60,242.697599587 L 200,22.000000000"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra1","T1-E1"],"universe":2,"start":0,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T1-E2" d="M 200,22.000000000 L 340,242.697599587"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra1","T1-E2"],"universe":2,"start":23,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T1-E3" d="M 340,263.822529545 L 60,263.822529545"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra1","T1-E3"],"universe":2,"start":46,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T1-E4" d="M 60,263.822529545 L 200,263.822529545"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra1","T1-E4"],"universe":2,"start":69,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T1-E5" d="M 200,263.822529545 L 340,263.822529545"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra1","T1-E5"],"universe":2,"start":92,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T1-E6" d="M 200,22.000000000 L 200,242.697599587"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra1","T1-E6"],"universe":2,"start":115,"count":23}</desc></path>
    </g>
    <!-- T2: downward tetrahedron; all horizontal profiles remain level. -->
    <g stroke="#f5b779">
      <path id="T2-E1" d="M 200,378.000000000 L 60,157.302400413"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra2","T2-E1"],"universe":2,"start":138,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T2-E2" d="M 60,129.488310861 L 200,129.488310861"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra2","T2-E2"],"universe":2,"start":161,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T2-E3" d="M 200,129.488310861 L 340,129.488310861"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra2","T2-E3"],"universe":2,"start":184,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T2-E4" d="M 340,157.302400413 L 200,378.000000000"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra2","T2-E4"],"universe":2,"start":207,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T2-E5" d="M 200,378.000000000 L 200,157.302400413"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra2","T2-E5"],"universe":2,"start":230,"count":23}</desc></path>
      <path id="T2-E6" d="M 340,129.488310861 L 60,129.488310861"><desc>{"groups":["all","tetra2","T2-E6"],"universe":2,"start":253,"count":23}</desc></path>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
